Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have a question regarding playing reaction cards. The rule book says that
playing a reaction cards does not tap a vampire. However, a group I've played
with a while ago is tapping their vampires when they play reaction cards. Which
is correct?

Thanks,

Yaz

Messages.Author: Gord Culleton
Messages.Body:
> I have a question regarding playing reaction cards. The rule book says that
> playing a reaction cards does not tap a vampire. However, a group I've played
> with a while ago is tapping their vampires when they play reaction cards. Which

> Thanks,
> Yaz

The reaction cards *DO NOT* tap the reacting minion unless
specifically stated on the card, like Fast Reactions.
In the (tongue-in-cheek) Rulebook, page 15, sec. 7.2.2
Reaction Cards: Yada yada...Reaction cards do not tap
the minion using the card. Okey doke?

Jere Culleton (Rush Rules!!!)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Playing a reaction card does not tap the reacting minion, but only an
untapped minion may react to an action.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Peace be with you,

Playing a reaction card does not tap the playing minion, UNLESS the card explicitly
states that playing that cards does tap the reacting minion, e.g.: sup Telepathic
Misdirection or inf Deflection.
